name: n8n
description: Connect your own n8n instance (self-hosted or n8n Cloud) to see and manage your workflows from Imperal -- list workflows with their status, publish/unpublish them, run one on demand where your instance supports it, inspect executions, and manage credentials. Your n8n API key is verified against your own instance before it's saved.

tools.name: connect_n8n
tools.description: Connect your n8n instance by saving its base URL and your own API key, after checking they actually work together. Create the key in your instance: Settings -> n8n API -> Create an API key. Works for both self-hosted n8n and n8n Cloud -- just paste your instance's own URL, there's no auto-detection since n8n has no fixed set of hosts the way Make.com does.

base_url.description: Base URL of your n8n instance, e.g. https://n8n.example.com (self-hosted) or https://your-org.app.n8n.cloud (n8n Cloud).
base_url.title: Base Url

api_key.description: n8n API key -- create it in your instance: Settings -> n8n API -> Create an API key.
api_key.title: Api Key

tools.name: disconnect_n8n
tools.description: Disconnect n8n: deletes the saved base URL and API key. Existing workflows/executions on your own n8n instance are untouched.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: get_n8n_connection
tools.description: Check whether n8n is currently connected (does not reveal the saved base URL or API key).

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: list_n8n_workflows
tools.description: List workflows on your connected n8n instance -- name, active state, and tags. Supports filtering by active state and/or tags.

active.description: Filter by active/published state. Omit for all.
active.title: Active

tags.description: Comma-separated tag names to filter by.
tags.title: Tags

limit.description: Max workflows to return per page.
limit.title: Limit

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.
cursor.title: Cursor

tools.name: get_n8n_workflow
tools.description: Read one n8n workflow in full -- its nodes, connections, and active state.

tools.name: create_n8n_workflow
tools.description: Create a brand-new workflow on your n8n instance from an explicit node/connection definition (n8n's own workflow JSON format).

nodes.description: n8n node definitions -- see n8n's workflow JSON format.
nodes.title: Nodes

connections.description: n8n node connection map -- see n8n's workflow JSON format.
connections.title: Connections

tools.name: update_n8n_workflow
tools.description: Update an existing n8n workflow's name, nodes, and/or connections. n8n's PUT /workflows/{id} replaces the whole entity, so this reads the current workflow first and merges in only the fields you gave.

workflow_id.description: n8n workflow id to update (see list_workflows).
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

name.description: New name. Leave empty to keep the current one.
name.title: Name

nodes.description: Full replacement node list. Omit to keep current nodes.
nodes.title: Nodes

connections.description: Full replacement connection map. Omit to keep current connections.
connections.title: Connections

tools.name: delete_n8n_workflow
tools.description: Permanently delete a workflow from your n8n instance. Cannot be undone.

workflow_id.description: n8n workflow id to permanently delete (see list_workflows).
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

tools.name: publish_n8n_workflow
tools.description: Publish (activate) an n8n workflow so its triggers start running. This is n8n's current API -- the older activate/deactivate endpoints are deprecated.

workflow_id.description: n8n workflow id to publish/activate (see list_workflows).
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

tools.name: unpublish_n8n_workflow
tools.description: Unpublish (deactivate) an n8n workflow so its triggers stop running.

workflow_id.description: n8n workflow id to unpublish/deactivate (see list_workflows).
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

tools.name: run_n8n_workflow
tools.description: Run an n8n workflow right now by id. This endpoint is recent in n8n's own API (added late 2025) -- older self-hosted instances may not have it; if it fails, trigger the workflow via its own Webhook node URL instead.

workflow_id.description: n8n workflow id to run right now (see list_workflows).
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

tools.name: list_n8n_executions
tools.description: List past/current executions on your connected n8n instance -- status, workflow, and timing. Filter by status and/or workflow id.

status.description: Filter: success, error, waiting. Empty for all.
status.title: Status

workflow_id.description: Filter to one workflow's executions. Empty for all.
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

limit.description: Max executions to return per page.
limit.title: Limit

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.
cursor.title: Cursor

tools.name: get_n8n_execution
tools.description: Read one n8n execution in full, optionally including its run data.

include_data.description: Include the execution's full run data (larger response).
include_data.title: Include Data

tools.name: delete_n8n_execution
tools.description: Permanently delete one n8n execution record. This does not affect the workflow itself -- only its execution history.

execution_id.description: n8n execution id to permanently delete (see list_executions).
execution_id.title: Execution Id

tools.name: retry_n8n_execution
tools.description: Retry a failed n8n execution.

execution_id.description: n8n execution id to retry (see list_executions).
execution_id.title: Execution Id

tools.name: stop_n8n_execution
tools.description: Stop one currently-running n8n execution.

execution_id.description: n8n execution id to stop (see list_executions).
execution_id.title: Execution Id

tools.name: stop_n8n_executions
tools.description: Stop several currently-running n8n executions at once.

execution_ids.description: n8n execution ids to stop, in one call.
execution_ids.title: Execution Ids

tools.name: list_n8n_credentials
tools.description: List credentials stored on your connected n8n instance -- name and type only, never their secret field values (n8n's own API never returns those either).

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: get_n8n_credential_schema
tools.description: Read the field schema for one n8n credential type (e.g. 'openAiApi') -- which fields it needs -- before creating a credential of that type.

credential_type_name.description: n8n credential type name, e.g. 'openAiApi', 'clickUpApi'. Ask the user for the exact type if unsure -- it must match n8n's own naming.
credential_type_name.title: Credential Type Name

tools.name: create_n8n_credential
tools.description: Create a new credential on your connected n8n instance. WARNING: this stores sensitive data (API keys, passwords, tokens) on your n8n instance -- only do this for credentials you intend workflows to use. n8n has no update endpoint: to change a credential later you must delete it and create it again.

name.description: Display name for the new credential.
name.title: Name

data.description: Credential field values matching the type's schema (see get_credential_schema).
data.title: Data

tools.name: delete_n8n_credential
tools.description: Permanently delete a credential from your connected n8n instance. Workflows using it will fail until re-configured. This is also the only way to 'change' a credential -- n8n has no update endpoint, so delete this one and create_n8n_credential a replacement.

credential_id.description: n8n credential id to permanently delete (see list_credentials).
credential_id.title: Credential Id

tools.name: list_n8n_tags
tools.description: List tags defined on your connected n8n instance.

limit.description: Max tags to return per page.
limit.title: Limit

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.
cursor.title: Cursor

tools.name: create_n8n_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag on your connected n8n instance.

tools.name: update_n8n_tag
tools.description: Rename a tag on your connected n8n instance.

tag_id.description: n8n tag id to rename (see list_tags).
tag_id.title: Tag Id

tools.name: delete_n8n_tag
tools.description: Permanently delete a tag from your connected n8n instance. Workflows keep working -- they just lose this tag.

tag_id.description: n8n tag id to permanently delete (see list_tags).
tag_id.title: Tag Id

tools.name: get_n8n_workflow_tags
tools.description: Read the tags currently assigned to one n8n workflow.

tools.name: update_n8n_workflow_tags
tools.description: Replace the full set of tags assigned to one n8n workflow (pass every tag id that should remain, not just the ones to add).

tag_ids.description: Full replacement list of tag ids to assign to this workflow.
tag_ids.title: Tag Ids

tools.name: list_n8n_workflow_versions
tools.description: List the saved version history of one n8n workflow.

tools.name: get_n8n_workflow_version
tools.description: Read one specific saved version of an n8n workflow in full.

tools.name: unarchive_n8n_workflow
tools.description: Unarchive a previously archived n8n workflow, making it visible and editable again.

workflow_id.description: n8n workflow id to unarchive (see list_workflows).
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

tools.name: transfer_n8n_workflow
tools.description: Move an n8n workflow to a different project (Enterprise/multi-project instances only).

workflow_id.description: n8n workflow id to transfer (see list_workflows).
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

destination_project_id.description: Target project id to move the workflow into.
destination_project_id.title: Destination Project Id

tools.name: get_n8n_execution_tags
tools.description: Read the tags currently assigned to one n8n execution.

tools.name: update_n8n_execution_tags
tools.description: Replace the full set of tags assigned to one n8n execution.

tag_ids.description: Full replacement list of tag ids to assign to this execution.
tag_ids.title: Tag Ids

tools.name: get_n8n_credential
tools.description: Read one credential's metadata (name, type, timestamps) -- never its secret field values, which n8n's API never returns after creation.

tools.name: update_n8n_credential
tools.description: Update a credential's name and/or its field values on your connected n8n instance. WARNING: this stores sensitive data -- only use when you trust the source of the new values.

credential_id.description: n8n credential id to update (see list_credentials).
credential_id.title: Credential Id

name.description: New display name. Leave empty to keep the current one.

credential_type_name.description: New credential type name -- required only if changing type, must be paired with data.
credential_type_name.title: Credential Type Name

data.description: New credential field values (see get_credential_schema). Required if changing type.
data.title: Data

is_partial_data.description: If true, merges the given data into the existing (unredacted) data instead of replacing it entirely.
is_partial_data.title: Is Partial Data

tools.name: test_n8n_credential
tools.description: Test whether a credential's stored values still work against its target service.

credential_id.description: n8n credential id to test (see list_credentials).
credential_id.title: Credential Id

tools.name: transfer_n8n_credential
tools.description: Move a credential to a different project (Enterprise/multi-project instances only).

credential_id.description: n8n credential id to transfer (see list_credentials).
credential_id.title: Credential Id

destination_project_id.description: Target project id to move the credential into.
destination_project_id.title: Destination Project Id

variable_id.title: Variable Id

tools.name: list_n8n_users
tools.description: List users on your connected n8n instance. Only meaningful on multi-user (Enterprise) instances -- self-hosted single-owner instances will just show the one owner account.

limit.description: Max users to return per page.
limit.title: Limit

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.
cursor.title: Cursor

include_role.description: Whether to include each user's global role in the results.
include_role.title: Include Role

tools.name: create_n8n_users
tools.description: Invite one or more new users to your connected n8n instance by email. Enterprise feature -- fails on Community edition instances.

invites.description: List of {email, role} dicts to invite, e.g. [{'email': 'a@b.com', 'role': 'global:member'}].
invites.title: Invites

tools.name: get_n8n_user
tools.description: Read one user's profile on your connected n8n instance, by id or email.

include_role.description: Whether to include the user's global role.
include_role.title: Include Role

tools.name: delete_n8n_user
tools.description: Permanently delete a user from your connected n8n instance. Their workflows and credentials are NOT deleted -- transfer ownership first if needed.

id_or_email.description: User id or email address to permanently delete.
id_or_email.title: Id Or Email

tools.name: change_n8n_user_role
tools.description: Change a user's global role on your connected n8n instance (e.g. 'global:admin', 'global:member').

tools.name: pull_n8n_source_control

force.description: Discard uncommitted local changes/merge conflicts and force the pull.
force.title: Force

auto_publish.description: Publishing behavior after import: 'none' (keep local published state), 'all' (publish everything imported), or 'published' (only what was published locally before).
auto_publish.title: Auto Publish

tools.name: generate_n8n_audit
tools.description: Generate a security audit report for your connected n8n instance -- flags risky nodes, exposed credentials, outdated workflows, and more.

days_abandoned_workflow.description: Workflows with no executions in this many days are flagged as abandoned.
days_abandoned_workflow.title: Days Abandoned Workflow

categories.description: Which risk categories to include: credentials, database, filesystem, nodes, instance. Empty for all.
categories.title: Categories

secrets.name: n8n_base_url
secrets.description: Base URL of your n8n instance, e.g. https://n8n.example.com (self-hosted) or https://your-org.app.n8n.cloud (n8n Cloud). No trailing slash needed.

secrets.name: n8n_api_key
secrets.description: n8n API key -- create it in your n8n instance: Settings -> n8n API -> Create an API key. Verified against your instance before saving.

panels.title: How to get an n8n API key

pricing.notes: BYO n8n instance connector -- user runs/pays for their own n8n (self-hosted or Cloud). Priced per-action on the mandatory fixed platform scale {0,8,16,20,40,60}: 0=credential setup only, 8=read, 16=standard single write, 20=action that executes real work right now (run_n8n_workflow, pull_n8n_source_control), 40=heavy diagnostic/aggregation (generate_n8n_audit), 60=bulk (stop_n8n_executions). See PRICING_HISTORY.md for full rationale.
